title: Petrol
tagline: Social project to spread anonymous positive enouragements. Go vote on your peers and lets them findout who is who!
description: Social project to spread anonymous positive encouragement.  Go vote on your peers and let them find out who is who!  Unlock a special feature to see user comments. Get notified when someone adds a vote on your address name. Community-curated social experience of positivity in public!
how_its_made: We used smart contract together with air stack and wallet connect notifications. Everything packed together with wagmi, nextjs and other tools. We tried to use Lens SDK however was not possible to get a hold on to it. We tried our best to make it work, however it was not possible.
